items.title: Sudarshan Chemical Q2 FY27: consolidated profit Rs 30.5 crore on revenue of Rs 2,742.6 crore
items.text: Sudarshan Chemical reported consolidated revenue from operations of Rs 2,742.6 crore for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, against Rs 2,387.4 crore a year earlier. Profit was Rs 30.5 crore versus Rs 19.3 crore, after exceptional items of Rs 74.5 crore in termination benefits tied to German employee restructuring and Rs 8.4 crore of disposal-related expenses. The company completed the sale of its 100% stake in VP4 Frankfurt GmbH to Celanese US Holdings LLC for EUR 75.8 million. The article gives no pigment-segment or EBITDA split, so the read-through to Pc blue is limited.

items.title: Meghmani Organics Q2 FY27 PAT Rs 33.88 crore; pigments add Rs 7.27 crore to PBT
items.text: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, Meghmani reported consolidated revenue from operations of Rs 666.92 crore (Rs 577.26 crore in Q2 FY26) and PAT of Rs 33.88 crore (Rs 11.55 crore). Agrochemicals contributed Rs 53.14 crore of PBT, while pigments added Rs 7.27 crore; the article gave no pigment revenue figure. Profit remains agrochemical-led, so the Pc blue pigment exposure is a modest contributor. The earnings call on 5 November may add detail on pigment utilisation.

items.title: Sudarshan Colorants India Q2 FY27 profit up 48% to Rs 24.13 crore on 47% higher revenue
items.text: Sudarshan Colorants India reported Q2 FY27 (quarter to 30 Sep 2026) revenue of Rs 269.76 crore versus Rs 183.14 crore a year earlier, and net profit of Rs 24.13 crore versus Rs 16.28 crore. The company is still awaiting settlement of an insurance claim for the January 2025 warehouse fire at its Roha plant. It is listed as an 'other' name on this page, not a phthalocyanine maker, so the read-across to Pc pigments is indirect.

items.title: Sudarshan Chemical faces Maharashtra GST search; says no material impact
items.text: The Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, Maharashtra began a search and inspection on 1 October 2026 under Section 67 of the Maharashtra GST Act, 2017, covering the company's manufacturing and office facilities in the state. Management said it is cooperating fully and that the proceeding currently has no material impact on its financial health or day-to-day operations; no figures were disclosed. Sudarshan is the largest listed Indian pigment maker, so the outcome is worth watching.

items.title: Sudarshan Chemical completes Rs 150.76 crore purchase of 15.89% of Sudarshan Colorants India
items.text: Sudarshan Chemical completed the acquisition of 36,68,036 equity shares (15.89%) of Sudarshan Colorants India, formerly Heubach Colorants India, for Rs 150.76 crore, at about Rs 411 per share, from its wholly owned Sudarshan Europe B.V. The deal is part of a plan to reach a 70.26% stake. DSIJ describes it as a holding-structure consolidation within the group, not a new operating business, and management said it would not affect the underlying business. It follows the share purchase agreement signed on 28 September.

items.title: Sudarshan Chemical signs deal to buy 15.89% of Sudarshan Colorants India from Dutch unit
items.text: Sudarshan Chemical Industries signed an agreement on 28 September to acquire 3,668,036 shares (15.89%) of Sudarshan Colorants India (formerly Heubach Colorants India) for Rs 150.76 crore, or Rs 410 per share. The seller is its wholly owned subsidiary Sudarshan Europe B.V., so this is an internal restructuring and not a new economic stake bought from an outsider. Completion is due on or after 29 September, and the company plans to hold 70.26% directly, as announced on 12 August 2026. It simplifies the holding structure of the Heubach pigment business in India.
